name: Weather Plugin
description: Get current weather information using Open-Meteo API (no API key required)
author: RikkaHub

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Get current weather for a location by latitude and longitude. Returns temperature, weather condition, wind speed and humidity.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Latitude of the location (e.g. 39.9 for Beijing)

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Longitude of the location (e.g. 116.4 for Beijing)

tools.name: geocode
tools.description: Convert a city name to latitude and longitude coordinates for use with get_weather.
